# AI blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The AI blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## vector-search

search_<table>(query, k) for each table in vectorSearch: the k nearest rows the caller can read, with pgvector iterative index scans so RLS filters still return k rows.

- Title: Vector search
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/vector-search
- Modes: `managed`

## ai-chat

Chats, projects, participants and a message tree (or one linear list) in the canonical AI message format or the SDK's own parts, with runs (and the id of a durable engine's run), run steps for progress, a compare-and-set stream claim, harness sessions, tool approvals and policies, pending inputs, cited sources, feedback, hashed share links, a model catalog per plan, moderation events and private Realtime topics per chat and per user.

- Title: AI chat
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/ai-chat
- Client: `aiChatBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/ai-chat`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `streams`
- Works with: `share-links`, `entitlements`, `ai-keys`, `approvals`, `data-lifecycle`, `teams`, `usage`
- Entities: `ai_chat`, `ai_project`
- Tables: `ai_chats`, `ai_projects`
- Permission keys: `ai_chat.read`, `ai_chat.create`, `ai_chat.share`, `ai_chat.moderate`, `ai_chat.manage`
- Events (`AiChatEvents`): `ai_chat.share_revoked`, `ai_chat.shared`, `ai_chat_message.completed`, `ai_tool_approval.decided`, `ai_tool_policy.updated`
- Env keys: `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`

## ai-files

Files and documents for AI chats: a private bucket whose policies only accept an upload a reserved record expects, provider file references with expiry, versioned documents with suggested edits, and a purge that hands back the objects to remove.

- Title: AI files
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/ai-files
- Client: `aiFilesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/ai-files`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `versions`
- Works with: `ai-chat`
- Entities: `ai_document`
- Tables: `ai_documents`
- Permission keys: `ai_files.upload`, `ai_files.manage`
- Provides: `files`

## knowledge

Documents and chunks for retrieval with an embedding and a tsvector each, scoped to an organization, agent, project, chat, user or record (subject) and grouped into collections with a visibility, a priority and grants, plus system documents shared with every tenant; hybrid search with reciprocal rank fusion, chunks that keep their embedding when unchanged, and an embed job per document when jobs is installed. With ai-files and jobs, queue_knowledge_file ingests a file through a job.

- Title: Knowledge
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/knowledge
- Client: `knowledgeBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/knowledge`
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `vector-search`
- Works with: `ai-chat`, `ai-files`, `queue`, `subjects`, `teams`
- Entities: `knowledge_document`
- Tables: `knowledge_documents`
- Permission keys: `knowledge.read`, `knowledge.write`, `knowledge.manage`
- Consumes: `files (optional)`

## memory

Memory for AI assistants: core memory as files under /memories edited with view, create, str_replace, insert, delete and rename with version checks; archival facts with hybrid similarity search; message embeddings to recall earlier chats, skipped for temporary chats; and versioned documents under an opaque scope key for agent runtimes such as eve.

- Title: Memory
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/memory
- Client: `memoryBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/memory`
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `vector-search`
- Works with: `ai-chat`
- Entities: `memory`
- Tables: `memories`
- Permission keys: `memory.read`, `memory.manage`

## agents

Custom assistants with instructions, a model, tools, connectors, knowledge scopes and starters; private until published to the organization or the public store, with installs, ratings and provider skills.

- Title: Agents
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/agents
- Client: `agentsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/agents`
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Entities: `agent`
- Tables: `agents`
- Permission keys: `agents.read`, `agents.write`, `agents.publish`, `agents.moderate`
- Events (`AgentsEvents`): `agent.archived`, `agent.created`, `agent.installed`, `agent.published`, `agent.purged`, `agent.restored`, `agent.uninstalled`, `agent.updated`

## ai-schedules

Prompts a user schedules on a cron, with a run per occurrence; the scheduler claims due tasks, queues an ai_task_run job when jobs is installed, and fails runs that stall.

- Title: AI scheduled tasks
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/ai-schedules
- Client: `aiSchedulesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/ai-schedules`
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `agents`, `ai-chat`, `queue`
- Entities: `ai_scheduled_task`
- Tables: `ai_scheduled_tasks`
- Permission keys: `ai_schedules.write`, `ai_schedules.manage`
- Consumes: `notifier (optional)`

## ai-cache

Model responses cached by a key the application derives from the request, with a TTL capped by maxTtl, hit counts and a purge of expired entries; only the service role reads and writes it.

- Title: AI response cache
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/ai-cache
- Client: `aiCacheBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/ai-cache`
- Modes: `managed`

## ai-keys

A tenant's own provider keys as credential_ref rows, and a registry of provider batch jobs with their results and a poll claim. Sandboxes live in ai-chat.

- Title: AI providers
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/ai-keys
- Client: `aiKeysBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/ai-keys`
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `ai-chat`
- Events (`AiKeysEvents`): `ai_provider_key.created`, `ai_provider_key.deleted`, `ai_provider_key.updated`

## prompts

Versioned prompt templates by name, per tenant or for the whole system, with labels such as production that point at one version; only the service role reads and writes them.

- Title: Prompts
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/prompts
- Client: `promptsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/prompts`
- Modes: `managed`

## ai-evals

Evaluation datasets of inputs and expected outputs (imported or taken from rated ai-chat replies), runs against a prompt version and model, a score per scorer and item, and a regression compare between two runs; only the service role reads and writes them.

- Title: AI evals
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/ai-evals
- Client: `aiEvalsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/ai-evals`
- Modes: `managed`
- Works with: `ai-chat`

## ai-guardrails

Input and output policies per agent (prompt-injection heuristics, PII redaction, topic deny lists, a tool depth limit) and a decision log; a blocked check records guardrail.blocked. Only the service role reads and writes them.

- Title: AI guardrails
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/ai-guardrails
- Client: `aiGuardrailsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/ai-guardrails`
- Modes: `managed`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`
- Events (`AiGuardrailsEvents`): `guardrail.blocked`
